title: MP Farmers to Receive Large Relief Package, Rs 1460.25 Crore Transferred into Accounts
summary: The Madhya Pradesh government has announced a large relief package for its 10.54 lakh farmers, with Rs 1460.25 crore transferred into their accounts under the PM Fasal Bima scheme. The move aims to provide financial assistance to farmers affected by the recent floods in the state.
summary_points: Madhya Pradesh government announces large relief package for 10.54 lakh farmers
Rs 1460.25 crore transferred into farmer accounts under PM Fasal Bima scheme
Move aims to provide financial assistance to farmers affected by recent floods in the state
